objective: Engineer a DeepSeek system that clears more parts than a single raw Codex Astra baseline on a declared short public test.
scope: Short public benchmark variant; no official full-task or global SOTA claim.

roles: perception_coordinator
Assign distinct perception/contact experiments and integrate measured findings.
motion_coordinator
Coordinate reachable motion, release, recovery and measured final integration.
camera_geometry
Backproject overhead depth using published calibration and reject bin walls.
surface_selection
Choose exposed reachable contact patches and avoid repeated failed targets.
ik_validation
Validate arm_grip site, joint dimensions, orientation and gravity compensation.
contact_approach
Implement slow final descent and contact electromagnet engagement.
pickup_detection
Use published force-torque observations to verify stable carried load.
safe_transit
Clear the rim and move above the conveyor without floor drops or bin strikes.
singulation
Separate nested brackets before releasing into the single-part nest.
nest_release
Place one bracket within the published nest and wait for settling.
recovery
Detect failed pickups and blocked nests; recover without repeated strikes.
cycle_timing
Reduce overhead while retaining stable contact and release.
contract_regression
Prevent import, reset, ndarray and control-shape failures.
integration
Combine tested complete-cycle components and regress the frozen final version.
deepseek.routing_lesson: Account one had almost all Task09 pacing wait; use fewer long-context conversations there at initial assignment when header-informed capacity permits. Never migrate a live conversation.

abort_conditions: Any stage misses its wall deadline.
Public simulations leave insufficient time for selection and reporting.

development.selection: Prefer fault-free measured actual clearances with reported penalties; never call successful imports or force readings a task win.
development.runtime_inputs: Published RGB-D, qpos/qvel, force-torque and calibration only; no privileged part poses or hidden seeds.

remaining_time_decision: Pause Task07 after both bounded public probes timed out; no paid DeepSeek run launched.
